## Content — steps involving *parent*

Kept 12 of 31 steps: 10 involve the slice variables, 2 enclose them (5, 7). 19 omitted in 3 markers.
Slice variables: *parent*; *previousSibling* (Let at 6).
Semantics: may; this algorithm only, callees are not followed.

To **insert** a [node](DOM#concept-node) *node* into a [node](DOM#concept-node) *parent* before null or a [node](DOM#concept-node) *child*, with an optional boolean ***suppressObservers*** (default false):

- [steps 1–4 omitted (6 steps): no use of *parent*]

5. If *child* is non-null:

    1. For each [live range](DOM#concept-live-range) whose [start node](DOM#concept-range-start-node) is *parent* and [start offset](DOM#concept-range-start-offset) is greater than *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index): increase its [start offset](DOM#concept-range-start-offset) by *count*.
    2. For each [live range](DOM#concept-live-range) whose [end node](DOM#concept-range-end-node) is *parent* and [end offset](DOM#concept-range-end-offset) is greater than *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index): increase its [end offset](DOM#concept-range-end-offset) by *count*.
6. Let *previousSibling* be *child*’s [previous sibling](DOM#concept-tree-previous-sibling) or *parent*’s [last child](DOM#concept-tree-last-child) if *child* is null.
7. For each *node* in *nodes*, in [tree order](DOM#concept-tree-order):

    1. [Adopt](DOM#concept-node-adopt) *node* into *parent*’s [node document](DOM#concept-node-document).
    2. If *child* is null, then [append](INFRA#set-append) *node* to *parent*’s [children](DOM#concept-tree-child).
    3. Otherwise, [insert](INFRA#list-insert) *node* into *parent*’s [children](DOM#concept-tree-child) before *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index).
    4. If *parent* is a [shadow host](DOM#element-shadow-host) whose [shadow root](DOM#concept-shadow-root)’s [slot assignment](DOM#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`named`" and *node* is a [slottable](DOM#concept-slotable), then [assign a slot](DOM#assign-a-slot) for *node*.
    5. If *parent*’s [root](DOM#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](DOM#concept-shadow-root), and *parent* is a [slot](DOM#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](DOM#slot-assigned-nodes) is the empty list, then run [signal a slot change](DOM#signal-a-slot-change) for *parent*.
    - [steps 7.6–7.7 omitted (9 steps): no use of *parent*]

8. If *suppressObservers* is false, then [queue a tree mutation record](DOM#queue-a-tree-mutation-record) for *parent* with *nodes*, « », *previousSibling*, and *child*.
9. Run the [children changed steps](DOM#concept-node-children-changed-ext) for *parent*.
- [steps 10–12 omitted (4 steps): no use of *parent*]
